text:
alina: heads-up: while onboarding skyline-7b-q4 with a 17k token prefill, outputs match until token 16384 then suddenly diverge. reproducible in local smoke.
oscar: wow that's right at the kv_window boundary (16384). can you paste the exact repro and a tiny log excerpt?
alina: repro cmd:
```
PYTHONPATH=. python -m tests.long_prefill_repro --model skyline-7b-q4 --prefill 17000 --seed 13 --no-stream
```
log snippet:
```
[2026-04-04 11:02:10] prefill=17000
[2026-04-04 11:02:10] kv_window=16384 shard=0
[2026-04-04 11:02:45] token=16383 logits OK
[2026-04-04 11:02:45] token=16384 KL=2.11 divergence
```
tasha: converter metadata on the model artifact shows `rope_scale: 1.41421356` (sqrt(2)). runtime default is 1.0. looks like converter applied a scale factor rather than normalization.
oscar: interesting — inverse of common 1/sqrt(2) we've seen elsewhere. could be a historical param flip during export. does fp16-convert reproduce it?
alina: i ran fp16 (no int4) and saw the same divergence when runtime used rope_scale=1.0. when i set runtime override to rope_scale=1.41421356 the outputs line up (KL ~0.01).
build-bot: ci job queued: longprefill/skyline-7b-q4/3278901234 :gear:
oscar: so root cause seems converter baked in a non-default rope_scale. quant packer may still be compounding: int4 runs show slightly higher KL at boundary vs fp16, but primary delta disappears with rope_scale override.
tasha: mitigation proposal: 1) runtime honor model-index rope_scale metadata as a per-model override; 2) add converter flag `--embed-rope-scale` and a validation check that runtime and model-index rope_scale match on load; 3) add a long-prefill (>10k) smoke to onboarding.
alina: i've opened ticket ML-4832 and attached reproduce steps + minimal artifacts. assigning to @oscar for runtime override and to @tasha for converter patch.
oscar: i'll push a runtime feature-flagged override today and run full smoke (streaming + sampling) before flipping on.
tasha: i'll change converter to export `rope_scale` in model-index.json and add a unit test ensuring conversion doesn't silently rescale. will also audit the packer for edge rounding issues at >16k prefill.
ci-bot: test-run started: longprefill/skyline-7b-q4/3278901234 (worker...)
build-bot: quick experiment results: override rope_scale -> boundary KL reduced from 2.11 -> 0.03. int4 with `--preserve-sign` reduces residual KL further.
oscar: next steps: push runtime override behind FF, update model catalog with an explicit `rope_scale` hint for skyline-7b-q4, and backport a warning on model load if model-index and runtime default mismatch. tag @product @oncall.
alina: artifacts and traces pinned: s3://redwood-ci/skyline-7b-q4/3278901234/trace.tar.gz. summary: converter-exported RoPE scaling mismatch caused long-prefill divergence at the kv_window boundary; short-term mitigation = runtime per-model rope_scale; longer term = converter fix + quant packer audit. :white_check_mark:
